name: Games
desc: Play games from your PC via Sunshine (Moonlight)

changes.summary: Games finds your PC by itself, also when the PC's firewall blocks the search
points: While Games is open and no PC answers, it searches again by itself - no need to restart the app after starting Sunshine
If the normal search finds nothing, Games also asks every address on your network on Sunshine's port (needs NotaTV 1.0.4)
The search stops as soon as a PC answers, or when you leave Games
